name: Part-whole bar model
description: Identify a whole and its component parts, then represent known and unknown quantities with aligned bar segments.

name: Comparison bar model
description: Represent two quantities as aligned bars to reason about how much more, less, or how many times as much.

name: Draw a diagram
description: Translate relationships in a problem into a visual diagram before choosing operations.

name: Look for a pattern
description: Identify regularity in examples or sequences and use it to reason about the next case.

name: Work backwards
description: Start from a known final condition and reverse the operations or relationships to recover an earlier value.

name: Guess and check
description: Make a reasoned trial, test it against the conditions, and refine the trial systematically.
